name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router patterns for Server Components, streaming, parallel/intercepting routes, SSR/SSG, data fetching/caching, and Server Actions.

Use for new or migrated App Router applications, full-stack features, and React Server Component optimization.

Core choices:
- Server Components (server): data fetching, heavy computation, secrets; default.
- Client Components (browser): interactivity, hooks, browser APIs; add `'use client'` only when needed.
- Static (build time): rarely changing content.
- Dynamic (request time): personalized/real-time data.
- Streaming (progressive): large pages/slow sources via `Suspense`.
- Colocate data fetching; use parallel routes for independent loading states.
- Server Actions support mutations and progressive enhancement.

Conventions: `app/layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx`, `not-found.tsx`, `route.ts`, `template.tsx`, `default.tsx`, `opengraph-image.tsx`. Use layouts/providers and metadata. Route handlers use `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` (`app/api/products/route.ts`, `app/api/products/[id]/route.ts`). Dynamic pages use `params: Promise<...>`, `generateMetadata`, `generateStaticParams`, and `notFound()`. Parallel slots use `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/page.tsx`; intercepting photo modal: `app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx`, full page `app/photos/[id]/page.tsx`.

Fetching:
`fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" })`; `fetch(url, { cache: "force-cache" })`; `fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 60 } })`; `fetch(url, { next: { tags: ["products"] } })`. Invalidate with `revalidateTag`/`revalidatePath` from `"next/cache"`.

**Don't pass serializable data** - Server → Client boundary limitations
**Don't use hooks in Server Components** - No useState, useEffect
**Don't fetch in Client Components** - Use Server Components or React Query
**Don't over-nest layouts** - Each layout adds to the component tree
**Don't ignore loading states** - Always provide loading.tsx or Suspense
